description: Reads one of the library guides. Without a section it returns the table of contents only, so you can ask for just the part you need. Guides: agents (how to direct and produce a film), director (story, sound, rhythm, camera, checks), technique (page contract, voice, music, mix), my-styles (making a style your own), tools (every command and flag), instruments (sampled instruments), readme, notice (licences).

full.description: Return the whole guide. Long; prefer a section.

section.description: Heading text (or part of it) to return, with its subsections.

name: read_guide
title: Read a guide
